note: Claim ledger. Each claim names a profile, one evidence tier, an artifact that exists, the profile fields it depends on and a standing. A claim that depends on a field tagged tier4-community, tier5-emulator-hint, inference or unknown-default-chosen is provisional. Vocabulary: docs/evidence-tiers.md.

claims.statement: On the CP-1600 manual's reading, a push writes the word at the address held in R6 and then increments R6, and a pull first decrements R6 and then reads, so the stack grows toward higher addresses.
claims.note: The expectation comes from three manual pages read in plan 01-02 (C17 resolved-primary). Applying the CP-1600 manual to the CP-1610 is an inference logged as C31 in the discrepancy log, so the claim stays provisional.

claims.statement: The NTSC STIC part of this profile is the AY-3-8900-1, operated from a 3.579545 MHz crystal.
claims.note: All three fields carry tier1-primary-doc tags citing the 1980 data catalog; the page was a research-era reading and is re-read when the profile is next revised. The claim states only the printed figure; the exact crystal ratio is logged as C9. The STIC1A variant is not modelled.

claims.statement: A nominal NTSC frame is 262 scanlines times 57 CPU cycles, which is 14,934 CPU cycles and 59,736 master ticks.
claims.note: The scanline and per-scanline counts are tier4-community and the ticks per CPU cycle are an inference, so the weakest-field rule makes the claim provisional. A primary source or a measurement would resolve it.

claims.statement: The CP-1600 manual marks shifts and the instructions EIS, DIS, TCI, CLRC and SETC as not interruptible and says nothing about HLT, SDBD and MVO.
claims.note: This records what the manual pages say (C19 partial). Whether the silent cases are interruptible on the CP1610 is unresolved, and applying the CP-1600 manual to the CP1610 is an inference logged as C31.

claims.statement: Every one of the 1024 10-bit opcode decle patterns maps to exactly one most-specific row of the CP-1610 family table, with one documented coincidence (0010 111 111: TSTR R7, JR R7 and MOVR R7,R7).
claims.note: The table is transcribed from the CP-1600 manual page images and the coverage check proves the rows tile the decle space, not that any encoding, cycle count or status bit was read correctly. Applying the CP-1600 manual to the CP1610 is an inference logged as C31, so the claim stays provisional.
